name: gum-jsx
description: Create diagrams, plots, mathematical figures, maps, and slides with Gum.

interface.longDescription:
Create and revise diagrams, data plots, mathematical figures, geographic maps, and slide decks with Gum. Get editable JSX source and export SVG, PNG, or PDF files.

Rendering requires an environment that can run commands and a separate Gum executable. The skill reuses a known renderer, checks the local installation through npm, then checks PATH. If needed, it installs the CLI with npm and Node.js 24+ in a dedicated tools or temporary directory. Bun 1.4.2+ works equally well. It invokes the local renderer by its exact path without global installation or PATH changes. Setup honors explicit preferences and installation restrictions. Installing this plugin does not install the renderer.

If your environment cannot run commands, or you decline setup, you can still get JSX source and rendering instructions.
defaultPrompt: Use Gum to diagram a browser sending requests to an API server backed by a database. Export an SVG.
Use Gum to plot points (1, 3), (2, 5), (3, 4), and (4, 8) as a labeled line chart. Export a PNG.
Create a three-slide Gum deck explaining the Pythagorean theorem with a labeled diagram, and export it as PDF.
